title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Billing Terms: Member Payments
content:
## Billing terms: payments on a Home Delivery Pharmacy account

**Terms in force.** A payment lowers the balance due by its amount and is applied to the oldest charges first; a payment larger than the balance due leaves a credit balance. Payments are taken by credit card, debit card, check or, where the program accepts them, an HSA or FSA card. A payment made as an installment of a payment plan carries its installment number; other payments carry installment number zero. A payment may be taken only on an account that is not closed.

**Retired clause, no longer in force.** The former term that each order charge is due within the program's payment term of 30 calendar days of shipment (the figure every Home Delivery Pharmacy program shows) is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis on which a charge falls past due, and it is not applied.

### Accepting a payment: account status

| Account status (system record) | Payment may be taken |
|---|---|
| Registered | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| On hold | Yes |
| Closed | No |

### How a payment is applied (hypothetical figures)

An account owes 40.00 from an order shipped in March and 25.00 from an order shipped in April, a balance due of 65.00.

- A payment of 50.00 settles the March charge and 10.00 of the April charge, leaving a balance due of 15.00.
- A payment of 80.00 settles both charges and leaves a credit balance of 15.00.

### Installment numbering

| Payment | Installment number carried |
|---|---|
| An installment of a payment plan | its installment number |
| Any other payment | 0 |

superseded_clauses: each order charge is due within payment_due_days of shipment
